arguments.description: Transform this hall into one compact branch-house residence: one rough-barked trunk supports a single curved timber home with a deep green leaf-shingle roof, carved front door, woven walls, a small open balcony, golden lantern and short root stairs. One building only. Preserve the exact source pixel density, forest palette, refined wood shading, shallow three-quarter low-top-down view and upper-left light. Transparent background, no painted ground or cast shadow. Leave 6px clear border.
